A '''lieutenant''' in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|navy]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Silent Water]]'' during the [[Battle of Heterkus]].

==Biography==
A [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] served as [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Silent Water]]'' during the [[Battle of Heterkus]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Three [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] were [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarding]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Heterkus]] from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] when the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]] arrived; [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Silent Water'', ordered the lieutenant to accelerate toward the lead [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]], the ''[[Relentless (Dorja)|Relentless]]''.<ref name="Rules Companion" />

[[File:Relentless-Otherspace.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''Relentless'']]
When the lieutenant pointed out that their target was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], Tallon riposted that he knew something of its [[Commander/Legends|commander]]&mdash;Captain [[Westen]]&mdash;and crew. He then asked the [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]], [[G'hengle]], to open a channel to Westen, so the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] would know who he was fighting.<ref name="Rules Companion" />
